base: prolonge EUL1 (source/entree_underground_lake_sud_nord_v1) ; aucun emprunt aux branches soeurs
biome: Fin Underground Lake : rive du lac souterrain, prolongeant EUL1 ; a confirmer
method: textures canoniques = rendu genere REFERENCE : rip passe au generateur ; decor complet sur magenta (lac = magenta), sol complet edite depuis le decor, planche gouttes/ronds reutilisee d EUL1

reference_da.titre: Rive du lac souterrain (Underground Lake, PMD Explorers)

generation.prompt: Use EXACTLY the same textures, palette and pixel-art style as the reference image (Pokemon Mystery Dungeon Explorers of Sky, Underground Lake shore): same pale yellow sand with soft stippled texture, same olive-khaki bumpy cave walls made of stacked rounded rock lumps with dark gaps, same tall rock pillars rising from the water, same small pointed stalagmites standing in the water. Make a NEW, larger top-down map. WIDE LANDSCAPE 4:3 (1200x896), zoomed out so the cave feels vast. Layout: the player arrives at the SOUTH (bottom edge center) on a wide pale-yellow sand path between bumpy olive-khaki rock walls; the path opens into a wide rounded pale-yellow sand shore arena in the lower-middle of the map; the entire NORTHERN half of the map (and wrapping slightly around the left and right flanks of the sand shore) is a vast underground lake. Two massive tall rock pillars stand in the lake at the north on the left and right of center, with several small pointed stalagmites dotting the lake water around them; thick bumpy olive-khaki cave rock walls frame the left edge, right edge, bottom corners, and upper-left/upper-right corners. No dark tunnel opening at the top. IMPORTANT: fill the entire underground lake water surface with flat pure solid magenta #FF00FF (RGB 255, 0, 255), with no ripples, no cyan glow, and no reflections painted on the water. No characters, no text, no UI, no border.

Same image, same framing and pixel-art style (1200x896), but remove the magenta lake, the two tall rock pillars, and all small pointed stalagmites in the lake, replacing them with seamless plain pale yellow stippled sand ground; keep the outer olive-khaki bumpy cave walls at the exact same pixel positions. No characters, no text, no UI, no border.

Pixel-art sprite sheet on a flat pure magenta #FF00FF background, same style and colors as the reference. 2 rows of 6 small separate sprites. Row 1: a pale blue water drop falling then splashing. Row 2: a thin pale blue ripple ring growing from small to large. Sprites well separated, no text.

sol_complet.note: le generateur a garde les parois (sous le calque parois) ; lac, piliers et stalagmites remplaces par du sable

fidelite_rip.methode: moyenne RGB par matiere, meme classifieur pixel sur le rip et sur le brut ; distance euclidienne
fidelite_rip.eau_et_lueur: couleurs EXACTES du rip (test : sous-ensemble des 69 couleurs du rip)

normalization.methode: moyenne ponderee par classe (BOX), attribution exclusive par poids maximal

segmentation: eau = magenta et frange violette (r-g > 60 et b-g > 60) dilates 2 px ; sable = jaune clair (r > 150, r-b > 50, lum > 140), grande composante, trous < 300 px combles ; ombres = sable a <= 16 px des parois et lum lissee 5 px < 187 ; berge = ni sable ni eau a <= 34 px de l eau et du sable ; piliers = roche ou le sol complet differe (ecart lisse 5 px > 25) ; parois = le reste

water.modele: structure et cadence riviere Metano (bande, frange dentelee, accent, aplat, onde voyageuse), couleurs EXACTES du rip ; bande = intermediaire ; sans liseré clair de rive
water.origine: pixels recalcules, pas de tuiles natives

lueur.origine: couleurs EXACTES du rip (coeur + 8 anneaux) ; forme, respiration et ondulation creees par nous

sparkles.origine: pixels et couleurs Metano NATIFS inchanges (aplat de surface retire)
sparkles.zone: coeur de la lueur (commun aux 12 phases), pas l eau sombre

gouttes.origine: dessin GENERE reutilise d EUL1 (8 couleurs tirees de la planche) ; chronologie, chute et placement crees par nous

shadows: calque ombres = bande de sable assombrie au pied des parois, separee du rendu genere (pas inventee)

access.rule: case bloquee si > 25 % hors sable (ombres comprises) ; bords nord, gauche et droit bloques ; aucune sortie
